newsitem.title: USA: Ice Ban to sell minority interest.
newsitem.headline: Ice Ban to sell minority interest.

text.p: Minnesota Corn Processors and Ice Ban America Inc said Monday the corn processor will acquire a minority interest in Ice Ban, which makes de-icing agents.
The corn processor will receive about 1.2 million shares, or 7.5 percent of the company in exchange for the corn waste product used to make Ice Ban, the companies said.
There is an option in the agreement for an additional purchase of shares on similar terms and conditions, the companies said.
Under the agreement, Ice Ban will also be able to use Minnesota Corn Processor transshipment terminals, while also receiving personnel and laboratory facilities from the corn processor.
